summary: Backend regression for P0 (Unified Gift Voucher / Gift Card stored-value lifecycle) and P1 (AI Marketing Email generator, AI Roster blackout enforcement, Customer Display live cart). 19/19 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration25_v26_gift_marketing.py. Verified: (1) POST /v26/vouchers kind=gift mints a paired gift_card in pending_activation with currentBalance=0, voucherId set, shared code+barcode. (2) GET /v26/gift-cards/lookup/{code} returns the card with current/initial balance. (3) Redeem on pending_activation → 400. (4) POST /v26/gift-cards/{code}/activate sets status=active, currentBalance=initial+bonus (100+20=120), writes 'activate' ledger row in db.gift_card_transactions. (5) Re-activate returns alreadyActive=true (idempotent). (6) Two partial redeems decrement atomically (120→90→65) and write 'redeem' ledger rows with correct balanceBefore/balanceAfter. (7) Insufficient balance redeem → 400 with 'insufficient' message. (8) GET /v26/gift-cards/{code}/transactions returns ledger in ascending createdAt order (activate first, then redeems), no _id leak. (9) GET /v26/gift-cards lists and status filter works. (10) POST /v26/gift-cards/sell with channel=counter immediately activates card AND writes an 'activate' ledger entry with balanceAfter==currentBalance. (11) POST /v26/marketing/email/generate returns non-empty draft (subject/emailBody/sms/cta all populated by LLM, status=draft, id=MKT-...) and persists in db.marketing_emails. (12) GET /v26/marketing/emails lists, PATCH updates subject (verified by re-fetch), DELETE removes (owner-only). (13) POST /api/staff/auto-roster honours blackoutDates: a staff with from=2026-06-08, to=2026-06-09 is EXCLUDED from Monday+Tuesday suggestions and appears in 'excluded' array with reason='TEST_holiday'. (14) POST /v26/cfd/push then GET /v26/cfd/enriched?terminalId=... returns the pushed cart with customerName='TEST_Diana', tableNumber=7, subtotal=14, isMember=true, pointsEarned non-negative int.

verification_results.counter_sell_immediate_activation: channel=counter immediately produces status=active card with activate ledger row
verification_results.marketing_email: generate (LLM populated subject/body/sms/cta) → list → patch (subject updated, verified by GET) → delete (owner-only) ALL PASS
verification_results.auto_roster_blackout_honoured: Staff with blackoutDates 2026-06-08..2026-06-09 NOT in Monday/Tuesday suggestions; appears in excluded[] with reason; functionality also confirmed when querying without weekStart (pre-existing Vaibhav blackout still respected)
verification_results.cfd_push_and_enriched: terminalId-scoped push then enriched returns full cart + customerName + tableNumber + pointsEarned

critical_code_review_comments: v26_commerce.py:485-505 — redeem_gift_card_partial uses find_one_and_update with return_document=False (default). The returned document is therefore the PRE-update doc, so balance_before = card.get('currentBalance', 0) is the OLD balance and balance_after = balance_before - amount is computed in Python rather than read from DB. This works correctly today but is fragile under concurrent redeems on the same card — two concurrent calls could each see the same pre-update balance and compute the same balance_before in their ledger rows. The DB-level $inc is still atomic so balance won't go negative, but the ledger rows could mis-report balanceBefore. Recommend return_document=True (post-update) and derive balance_before = post['currentBalance'] + amount.

v26_commerce.py:619-679 — generate_marketing_email silently returns an empty draft if the LLM call fails (out_or = {} from _llm_json error handler). The persisted row will have empty subject/body and a 200 OK back to the caller. Recommend raising 502/503 when LLM returns {} so the UI can show a retry affordance, OR returning a sentinel field like {generationFailed: true} on the response.

v26_commerce.py:42-46 — _new_code uses secrets.token_hex(4) → 16 bits of entropy after the 4-char prefix, ~4B possible codes. For a multi-tenant SaaS this is fine, but there is NO uniqueness enforcement in DB (no unique index on manualCode/barcode in commerce_vouchers or gift_cards). Add unique sparse indexes on (manualCode) and (barcode) in both collections so a collision raises DuplicateKeyError rather than silently issuing two cards with the same code.

v26_commerce.py:438-469 — activate_gift_card check at line 452 ('if status == active return alreadyActive') is a read-before-write race: two concurrent activate calls on a pending card will both pass the check and both write an 'activate' ledger entry. Use find_one_and_update({id: ..., status: 'pending_activation'}, {$set: {status: 'active', ...}}) and only write the ledger if matched, otherwise return alreadyActive.
v26_commerce.py:843 lines — file is approaching the 700-line guideline. Split into v26_gift_cards.py, v26_marketing.py, v26_events.py, v26_cfd.py for maintainability.

v26_commerce.py:476-480 — redeem amount validation only checks `> 0`; consider also rejecting non-finite (NaN/inf) and rounding to 2 decimal places server-side to avoid floating-point drift in the ledger.

v26_commerce.py:392-404 — lookup_gift_card is an UNAUTHENTICATED endpoint (no get_current_user). For a stored-value instrument this is a leak: anyone with a card code can query balance + recipient details. Add auth + role check (cashier/manager/owner) OR strip recipientEmail/purchaserEmail from the response if you keep it public for self-service balance checks.

v15_features.py:303-374 — auto_roster pool fill logic at line 358-359 fills the pool with the first N=target staff without considering blackouts for OTHER staff who could fill the gap. When the target staff is blacked out, the loop simply excludes them but doesn't backfill from beyond the first N — so on a blackout day a shift may be UNDERSTAFFED (e.g., 2 instead of 3) instead of pulling a 4th eligible person from the staff list. Recommend iterating ALL staff and stopping when pool reaches target, regardless of blackouts encountered.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed gift vouchers (kind=gift, $100+$20 bonus), counter-sold gift card ($50), marketing email draft (deleted at end of marketing class), set then cleared blackoutDates for first non-owner staff (Vaibhav) for 2026-06-08..2026-06-09, pushed CFD doc keyed by TEST_TERM_<uuid>. Gift cards and ledger entries are NOT cleaned up (intentional — they are stored-value instruments and the lifecycle assertions need them to persist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration25_v26_gift_marketing.py is the v26 commerce regression suite. Reuse classes: TestGiftCardLifecycle (10 tests in order: create → lookup → redeem-while-pending → activate → idempotent activate → partial redeems → insufficient → ledger order → list/filter), TestGiftCardSellCounter, TestMarketingEmail (cleans up its own draft), TestAutoRosterBlackouts (cleans up blackoutDates in teardown), TestCFD. The /api/auth/staff endpoint returns the staff list (NOT /api/staff/users which 404s). v26 routes are prefixed /api/v26/...; v15 features (including /api/staff/auto-roster) have no extra prefix. Marketing email generator depends on db.events / db.commerce_vouchers / db.loyalty_tiers having at least one row — the test creates gift vouchers first so this is satisfied. CFD enriched honours terminalId query param.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures after fixing test wiring (staff list endpoint was /api/auth/staff, not /api/staff/users).
